examples.en: The manager finally showed her hand.
examples.zh: 經理終於表明了自己的真正意向。

examples.en: He showed his hand by naming his preferred choice.
examples.zh: 他說出自己較偏好的選擇，暴露了真正意向。

meaning.en: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.
meaning.zh: 透露原本隱藏的計劃、意圖、取向、立場或資源；亮出底牌；表明真正意向。
naturalZh: 透露原本隱藏的計劃、意圖、取向、立場或資源

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; workplace discussions; sport; business deals; interviews; journalism; public affairs; general opinion writing.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬中性語域，可以自然地用於日常對話、工作討論、體育、商業交易、訪問、新聞及一般議論文章。
register.formalEn: In a highly formal legal or technical document, reveal one’s position, disclose one’s intention or state one’s preferred option may sometimes be clearer.
register.formalZh: 在非常正式的法律或技術文件中，使用 reveal one’s position、disclose one’s intention 或 state one’s preferred option 有時會更清晰。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.example: The manager finally showed her hand.

forms.form: Subject + show + possessive + hand + by + verb-ing.
forms.example: He showed his hand by naming his preferred choice.

forms.form: Subject + do not / did not / will not + show + possessive + hand.
forms.example: We will not show our hand until the other team makes its offer.

forms.form: Subject + may / might / could / should + show + possessive + hand.
forms.example: One careless remark could show our hand.

forms.form: Subject + has / have / had + shown + possessive + hand.
forms.example: The company may already have shown its hand.

forms.form: By + verb-ing, subject + show + possessive + hand.
forms.example: By rejecting the first offer, they showed their hand.

forms.form: If + subject + show(s) + possessive + hand, consequence.
forms.example: If we show our hand now, the seller may raise the price.

examples.zh: 我們在對方提出條件前不會亮出底牌。

examples.en: The director refused to show her hand.
examples.zh: 總監拒絕表明自己的意向。

examples.zh: 一句不小心的說話可能會暴露我們的計劃。

examples.zh: 公司可能已經暴露了自己的立場。

examples.zh: 他們拒絕第一個條件，因而表明了真正立場。

examples.en: If we show our hand now, the seller may raise the price.
examples.zh: 如果我們現在亮出底牌，賣方可能會提高價格。

benefits.en: The idiom packages secrecy, intention and revelation into one expression.
benefits.zh: 經理終於表明了真正立場。 這個慣用語把「保密」、「意向」和「透露」集中在一個表達之中。

examples.en: The manager finally showed her hand.
examples.zh: 經理終於表明了真正立場。

benefits.en: This warns somebody that revealing a plan at the wrong time may weaken their position.
benefits.zh: 不要太早亮出底牌。 這句話提醒別人，太早透露計劃可能會削弱自己的處境。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Describe Words or Actions
benefits.en: announcing a decision; making an offer; voting; rejecting an option; asking a revealing question; supporting one side.
benefits.zh: 一個人可以透過說話、投票、出價、拒絕某個選擇或支持某一方來表明真正意向。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Competition and Decision-Making
benefits.titleZh: 適合競爭及作決定的情境
benefits.en: It Is Useful for Competition and Decision-Making
benefits.zh: 適合競爭及作決定的情境

benefits.titleEn: It Can Express Deliberate or Unintended Revelation
benefits.titleZh: 可表示主動或意外暴露立場
benefits.en: It Can Express Deliberate or Unintended Revelation
benefits.zh: 她不斷提問，可能無意間暴露了自己的意向。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Not Always Better Than Plain English
benefits.titleZh: 並非永遠比普通表達更好
benefits.en: Use the idiom only when there was a genuinely hidden position, intention or resource.
benefits.zh: 只有在計劃、立場、意圖或資源原本被隱藏時，才應使用這個慣用語。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented Card-Game Origin; Exact First Figurative Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 紙牌遊戲來源有充分根據；確切首次比喻用法不明

history.en: Showing your cards removes the uncertainty about what you possess and what you may do next. The same image came to describe revealing a hidden plan, preference, position or level of power.
history.zh: 把手上的紙牌展示出來，會消除別人對你所掌握資源及下一步行動的疑問。 後來，相同意象便用來形容透露原本隱藏的計劃、取向、立場或實力。

origin.memoryEn: When other players can see your cards, they can understand your position; when people know your plan, you have shown your hand.
origin.memoryZh: 別人看見你的紙牌，便能了解你的處境；別人知道你的計劃，便代表你已經亮出底牌。

rules.titleEn: Match the Possessive to the Correct Person
rules.titleZh: 規則一：所有格必須與人物一致
rules.en: The person or group whose plan is revealed controls the possessive.
rules.zh: 被透露計劃或立場的人或團體，決定應使用哪一個所有格。

rules.titleZh: 規則二：一般過去式使用 showed

rules.titleEn: Use “Shown” After Have, Has or Had
rules.titleZh: 規則三：have、has 或 had 後使用 shown
rules.en: Use “Shown” After Have, Has or Had
rules.zh: have、has 或 had 後使用 shown

rules.en: In this exercise, a plural group shares one position or plan.
rules.zh: 在本練習中，一個團體具有共同立場，因此使用單數 hand。

rules.titleEn: Use It Only When Something Was Hidden
rules.titleZh: 規則六：必須有原本隱藏的資料
rules.en: He told me what time the shop closes. The second sentence contains information, but it does not involve a hidden plan, position or strategic choice.
rules.zh: 買家原本把出價上限保密，但她提出高價時暴露了底牌。 他告訴我店舖甚麼時候關門。 第二句雖然涉及提供資料，但沒有隱藏的計劃、立場或策略性選擇。

examples.en: The buyer had kept her limit secret, but her large offer showed her hand.
examples.zh: 買家原本把出價上限保密，但她提出高價時暴露了底牌。

rules.en: The incorrect version turns a possibility into a definite fact.
rules.zh: 錯誤版本把「可能」改成確定事實。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Literal and Figurative Meanings
rules.titleZh: 規則八：不要混淆字面及比喻意思
rules.en: The player showed the other players the cards in his hand. Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
rules.zh: 玩家向其他人展示自己手上的紙牌。 玩家承認自己想要哪一個結果，暴露了真正意向。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

examples.en: The player showed his hand by admitting which result he wanted.
examples.zh: 玩家承認自己想要哪一個結果，暴露了真正意向。

rules.titleEn: Related Expressions Are Not the Target
rules.titleZh: 規則九：相關表達不是本課目標
rules.en: Related Expressions Are Not the Target
rules.zh: 相關表達不是本課目標

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Revealing Somebody Else’s
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要用來表示洩露別人的秘密
rules.en: show your hand usually means revealing your own or your group’s plan, position or resources. If someone reveals another person’s private secret, a different expression is usually needed.
rules.zh: show your hand 通常表示透露自己或所屬團體的計劃、立場或資源。 如果某人洩露的是另一個人的私人秘密，通常需要使用其他表達。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using the correct form of show one’s hand.
instructions.zh: 使用 show one’s hand 的正確形式改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Sarah had kept her plan secret, but she finally said that she wanted to lead the project.
questions.promptZh: Sarah 原本把計劃保密，但她最後表示自己想帶領這個項目。
questions.answer: Sarah finally showed her hand by saying that she wanted to lead the project.
questions.answerZh: Sarah 最後表示自己想帶領這個項目，表明了真正意向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: Before the match, the coach revealed which player he planned to use as the goalkeeper.
questions.promptZh: 比賽前，教練透露了自己打算派哪一名球員擔任守門員。
questions.answer: The coach showed his hand before the match by naming the goalkeeper.
questions.answerZh: 教練在比賽前說出守門員人選，暴露了部署。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: I told the seller exactly how much I was willing to pay.
questions.promptZh: 我告訴賣方自己願意支付的確實金額。
questions.answer: I showed my hand by telling the seller exactly how much I was willing to pay.
questions.answerZh: 我告訴賣方自己願意支付的確實金額，亮出了底牌。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The company had kept its plans secret. Its email said that it would close two shops next year.
questions.promptZh: 公司原本把計劃保密，但其電郵表示公司明年會關閉兩間店舖。
questions.answer: The company showed its hand in the email by saying that it would close two shops next year.
questions.answerZh: 公司在電郵中表示明年會關閉兩間店舖，透露了真正計劃。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: Daniel finally said which side he supported.
questions.promptZh: Daniel 終於表示自己支持哪一方。
questions.answer: Daniel showed his hand by saying which side he supported.
questions.answerZh: Daniel 說出自己支持哪一方，表明了真正立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: We discussed our plan online, so the other team now knows what we intend to do.
questions.promptZh: 我們在網上討論計劃，因此對方現在已知道我們打算做甚麼。
questions.answer: We showed our hand by discussing our plan online.
questions.answerZh: 我們在網上討論計劃，因而暴露了意向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: When Amy voted against the change, everyone learnt her true position.
questions.promptZh: Amy 投票反對改動後，大家都知道了她的真正立場。
questions.answer: Amy showed her hand by voting against the change.
questions.answerZh: Amy 投票反對改動，表明了自己的真正立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The manager still has not said whether she supports the move.
questions.promptZh: 經理仍未表示自己是否支持這項改動。
questions.answer: The manager has not shown her hand on the proposed move yet.
questions.answerZh: 經理仍未表明自己對建議改動的真正立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: Do not tell the seller our highest price before the talks begin.
questions.promptZh: 在商談開始前，不要告訴賣方我們可以接受的最高價格。
questions.answer: Don’t show our hand by telling the seller our highest price before the talks begin.
questions.answerZh: 在商談開始前，不要把最高價格告訴賣方而亮出我們的底牌。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The club finally announced which coach it wanted to hire.
questions.promptZh: 球會終於宣佈自己想聘請哪一位教練。
questions.answer: The club finally showed its hand by naming the coach it wanted to hire.
questions.answerZh: 球會最後說出想聘請的教練人選，表明了真正意向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: At every planning meeting, Ben names his preferred option before anyone else speaks.
questions.promptZh: 在每次規劃會議中，Ben 都會在其他人發言前先說出自己較偏好的選擇。
questions.answer: Ben usually shows his hand too early by naming his preferred option at planning meetings.
questions.answerZh: Ben 通常會在規劃會議中太早說出較偏好的選擇，暴露自己的立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: She kept asking when she could start the job. This may have revealed that she wanted it.
questions.promptZh: 她不斷詢問自己何時可以開始工作。這可能透露了她想得到這份工作。
questions.answer: By asking when she could start the job, she may have shown her hand.
questions.answerZh: 她詢問何時可以開始工作，可能已暴露了自己想得到這份工作的意向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: We should keep our full plan secret at the first meeting.
questions.promptZh: 我們應在第一次會議中把完整計劃保密。
questions.answer: We should not show our hand at the first meeting.
questions.answerZh: 我們不應在第一次會議中亮出底牌。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: They refused the cheaper option, which made their position clear.
questions.promptZh: 他們拒絕了較便宜的選擇，因而表明了自己的立場。
questions.answer: They showed their hand by refusing the cheaper option.
questions.answerZh: 他們拒絕較便宜的選擇，因而表明了真正立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: If I tell them that I need an answer today, they will know that I am under pressure.
questions.promptZh: 如果我告訴他們自己今天便需要答覆，他們便會知道我正承受壓力。
questions.answer: If I tell them that I need an answer today, I will show my hand.
questions.answerZh: 如果我告訴他們自己今天便需要答覆，便會暴露我正承受壓力。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: He made the first offer on the house, revealing that he was serious about buying it.
questions.promptZh: 他率先為房屋出價，表明自己確實有意購買。
questions.answer: By making the first offer on the house, he has shown his hand.
questions.answerZh: 他率先為房屋出價，已表明自己確實有意購買。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: If the director publicly supported the plan, everyone would know her position.
questions.promptZh: 如果總監公開支持計劃，大家便會知道她的立場。
questions.answer: The director would show her hand by publicly supporting the plan.
questions.answerZh: 總監如果公開支持計劃，便會表明自己的立場。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The team will not announce its starting players until Friday.
questions.promptZh: 球隊在星期五前不會公佈正選球員名單。
questions.answer: The team will not show its hand until Friday, when it names its starting players.
questions.answerZh: 球隊要到星期五公佈正選球員時，才會暴露部署。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: One careless comment could reveal our whole plan.
questions.promptZh: 一句不小心的說話可能會暴露我們的整個計劃。
questions.answer: One careless comment could show our hand.
questions.answerZh: 一句不小心的說話可能會暴露我們的計劃。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: A: Has Ben said which offer he prefers? B: No. He has kept his decision secret.
questions.promptZh: 甲：Ben 有說自己較喜歡哪一個條件嗎？ 乙：沒有。他仍然把自己的決定保密。
questions.answer: No, Ben has not shown his hand yet.
questions.answerZh: 沒有，Ben 仍未表明真正取向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: A: Why did you not tell the seller that we could pay more? B: I did not want to reveal our highest price so early.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你為甚麼沒有告訴賣方我們可以支付更多？ 乙：我不想這麼早便透露我們的最高價格。
questions.answer: I did not want to show our hand by naming our highest price so early.
questions.answerZh: 我不想太早說出最高價格而亮出我們的底牌。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The minister refused to defend the old rule. This may suggest that he plans to change it.
questions.promptZh: 部長拒絕為舊有規則辯護。這可能表示他計劃作出改動。
questions.answer: The minister may have shown his hand by refusing to defend the old rule.
questions.answerZh: 部長拒絕為舊有規則辯護，可能已表明他打算作出改動。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: A: Why has the other team changed its defence? B: Perhaps the change reveals how it expects us to attack.
questions.promptZh: 甲：對方為甚麼改變防守方式？ 乙：這項改動可能透露了他們預計我們會如何進攻。
questions.answer: The other team may have shown its hand by changing its defence.
questions.answerZh: 對方改變防守方式，可能已暴露其部署。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: She had already chosen a group, but she refused to say which one until the final day.
questions.promptZh: 她早已選定一個小組，但在最後一天前一直拒絕說出是哪一組。
questions.answer: She refused to show her hand until the final day.
questions.answerZh: 她在最後一天前一直拒絕表明自己的選擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: Tom offered to do extra work without pay. Everyone realised that he wanted a promotion.
questions.promptZh: Tom 主動提出無薪完成額外工作，大家因而知道他想獲得升職。
questions.answer: Tom showed his hand by offering to do extra work without pay.
questions.answerZh: Tom 主動提出無薪完成額外工作，暴露了自己想獲得升職的意向。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: The buyer asked too many questions about the delivery date, making it clear that she was in a hurry.
questions.promptZh: 買家對送貨日期提出太多問題，暴露了她急於完成交易。
questions.answer: The buyer showed her hand by asking too many questions about the delivery date.
questions.answerZh: 買家對送貨日期提出太多問題，暴露了她急於完成交易。
questions.targetMeaning: To reveal a plan, intention, preference, position or resource that you had previously kept hidden.

questions.prompt: A: Why has the club not named its preferred player? B: It does not want the other clubs to know whom it plans to sign.
questions.promptZh: 甲：球會為甚麼仍未說出較想羅致哪一名球員？ 乙：球會不想讓其他球會知道自己計劃羅致誰。
questions.answer: The club does not want to show its hand by naming the player it plans to sign.
questions.answerZh: 球會不想說出計劃羅致的球員而暴露真正目標。
